guide_wording: **Professional shareholder valuation rule.** All conditions in LIS art. 18.6 must hold: **more than 75% of entity revenue** from professional activities; adequate people and equipment; total professional-shareholder remuneration **at least 75% of the result before that remuneration**; written allocation criteria reflecting each shareholder's contribution; and each person's remuneration at least **1.5 times** the average pay of comparable employees, or, if there are none, **five times IPREM**. These are different denominators. Failure of the individual minimum by one shareholder does not disqualify the others under the article. For a **full calendar year 2026** with no comparable employees, this Guide derives the individual minimum as **5 × annual IPREM of EUR 7,200 = EUR 36,000**. The actual [SEPE 2026 amounts](https://www.sepe.es/HomeSepe/prestaciones-desempleo/Cuantias-anuales.html) retain EUR 600 monthly and EUR 7,200 annually under [Law 31/2022, DA 90(c)](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2022-22128). DA 90(d)'s EUR 8,400 annual amount concerns the specified annual SMI references substituted under [RDL 3/2004, art. 2.3](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2004-12010); LIS art. 18.6 directly uses IPREM and gives no instruction to include fourteen payments. The EUR 36,000 result is this **reasoned statutory construction**, not a located AEAT/DGT numerical ruling. Do not use five times the monthly EUR 600 as the annual minimum or import a fourteen-payment uplift without establishing its legal basis. A part-year entitlement or apportionment needs its applicable method; this full-year calculation does not decide it.
